title: Hearty Spicy Venezuelan Chicken Skewers
description: A spicy and flavorful Venezuelan dish featuring chicken, galangal, and confit tomatoes, perfect for a post-workout meal. This recipe is raw-friendly and can be adjusted to suit individual tastes.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together the galangal, confit tomatoes, spicy Venezuelan sauce, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken, red onion, and red bell pepper to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the chicken and vegetables onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for up to 3 days.
Reheat the skewers in the microwave or oven until hot and crispy.
